name: ZT1 Toon Shaders
author: ZT1 Engine
about: A toon shader for the map's animals, people, fences and objects (flat colour, hard shadows, tinted shade, gloss, rim light, ink outlines), and a colour grade for the whole picture. Settings in Game Options > Shaders. Also an example of a shader mod: see shaders/*.json and *.frag.

settings.name: peopleOnly
settings.label: Animals and people only
settings.about: Only animals and people get the toon look; fences, buildings and objects stay as drawn.
